cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(EdgeFHE_Private_Analytics_V1 LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
find_package(OpenSSL 3 REQUIRED)
find_package(OpenFHE 1.5.1 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED)
if(NOT FROZEN_CLIENT)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Provide hash-checked frozen V8b SW2 client")
endif()
add_subdirectory("${FROZEN_CLIENT}" frozen_build EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
add_library(ef_app_owner SHARED native/owner.cpp)
target_include_directories(ef_app_owner SYSTEM PRIVATE "${FROZEN_CLIENT}")
target_link_libraries(ef_app_owner PRIVATE edgefhe_v7 OpenSSL::Crypto)
target_link_options(ef_app_owner PRIVATE "-Wl,--disable-new-dtags")
set_target_properties(ef_app_owner PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "${OpenFHE_LIBDIR}")
add_library(ef_app_cloud SHARED native/cloud.cpp)
add_executable(ef_app_math_selftest native/selftest.cpp)
target_include_directories(ef_app_math_selftest SYSTEM PRIVATE "${FROZEN_CLIENT}")
target_link_libraries(ef_app_math_selftest PRIVATE edgefhe_v7 ef_app_cloud OpenSSL::Crypto)
target_link_options(ef_app_math_selftest PRIVATE "-Wl,--disable-new-dtags")
set_target_properties(ef_app_math_selftest PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "${OpenFHE_LIBDIR}")
add_executable(ef_app_pl_selftest native/pl_selftest.cpp)
target_include_directories(ef_app_pl_selftest SYSTEM PRIVATE "${FROZEN_CLIENT}")
target_link_libraries(ef_app_pl_selftest PRIVATE edgefhe_v7 ef_app_cloud OpenSSL::Crypto)
target_link_options(ef_app_pl_selftest PRIVATE "-Wl,--disable-new-dtags")
set_target_properties(ef_app_pl_selftest PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "${OpenFHE_LIBDIR}")
add_executable(ef_app_owner_selftest native/owner_selftest.cpp)
target_link_libraries(ef_app_owner_selftest PRIVATE ef_app_owner ef_app_cloud)
# app v3 (2026-10-19): equivalence against v2 paths and API timing
add_library(ef_app_cloud_v2ref SHARED native_v2ref/cloud.cpp)   # unchanged v2 cloud, reference only
add_executable(ef_app_v3_equivalence native/v3_equivalence_selftest.cpp)
target_include_directories(ef_app_v3_equivalence SYSTEM PRIVATE "${FROZEN_CLIENT}")
target_link_libraries(ef_app_v3_equivalence PRIVATE edgefhe_v7 ef_app_cloud OpenSSL::Crypto ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
target_link_options(ef_app_v3_equivalence PRIVATE "-Wl,--disable-new-dtags")
set_target_properties(ef_app_v3_equivalence PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "${OpenFHE_LIBDIR}")
add_executable(ef_app_owner_timing native/owner_timing.cpp)
target_compile_definitions(ef_app_owner_timing PRIVATE EF_V3=1)
target_link_libraries(ef_app_owner_timing PRIVATE ef_app_owner ef_app_cloud)
foreach(t ef_app_owner ef_app_cloud ef_app_math_selftest ef_app_owner_selftest ef_app_pl_selftest ef_app_v3_equivalence ef_app_owner_timing ef_app_cloud_v2ref)
  target_compile_options(${t} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fno-fast-math)
endforeach()

# P1 app_v4: preserve crypto/profile; add stateless raw normalization target.
add_library(ef_app_normalize SHARED native/normalize.cpp)
target_compile_options(ef_app_normalize PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
add_executable(ef_app_normalize_selftest native/normalize_selftest.cpp)
target_link_libraries(ef_app_normalize_selftest PRIVATE ef_app_normalize)
target_compile_options(ef_app_normalize_selftest PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME p1_normalization_bits_refusal_wipe COMMAND ef_app_normalize_selftest)

# app v5 (2026-10-22): bit-exact equivalence against app_v4 arithmetic (CPU groups, spec frames, cloud, decrypt, API)
target_link_libraries(ef_app_cloud PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
add_executable(ef_app_v5_equivalence native/v5_equivalence_selftest.cpp)
target_include_directories(ef_app_v5_equivalence SYSTEM PRIVATE "${FROZEN_CLIENT}")
target_link_libraries(ef_app_v5_equivalence PRIVATE edgefhe_v7 ef_app_owner ef_app_cloud OpenSSL::Crypto Threads::Threads)
target_compile_options(ef_app_v5_equivalence PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fno-fast-math)
target_link_options(ef_app_v5_equivalence PRIVATE "-Wl,--disable-new-dtags")
set_target_properties(ef_app_v5_equivalence PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "${OpenFHE_LIBDIR}")
add_executable(ef_app_v5_pl_check native/v5_pl_check.cpp)
target_include_directories(ef_app_v5_pl_check SYSTEM PRIVATE "${FROZEN_CLIENT}")
target_link_libraries(ef_app_v5_pl_check PRIVATE edgefhe_v7 OpenSSL::Crypto Threads::Threads)
target_compile_options(ef_app_v5_pl_check PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fno-fast-math)
target_link_options(ef_app_v5_pl_check PRIVATE "-Wl,--disable-new-dtags")
set_target_properties(ef_app_v5_pl_check PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "${OpenFHE_LIBDIR}")
